If the cardinal ends in a vowel, add –ኛ–ňa.
Examples include አባቴ, አባትህ, አባትሽ, አባትዎ, አባቱ, አባቷ, አባታቸው.
If the cardinal ends in ኝ, change ኝ to n and add –ኛ äňa.
If the cardinal ends in a consonant other than ኝ, add –ኛ äña.
Recognize special consonant sounds such as ሸ, ጰ, ዠ, ጸ, ጠ and ጨ.

The source explains that አለ is irregular in the negative and uses የ- plus -ም in the negative form.
The source says ይህች and ያች can also show smallness/endearment or can function as diminutives marking disrespect.
